Trinity S³AI

Carry-save adders: add many numbers with almost no carries

Set how many numbers to add and watch 3:2 counters squeeze them to two, layer by layer, before a single carry-propagate adder. Then try one counter on three numbers.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/dsp/adders.t27 (t27#8985): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • L. Dadda, Some schemes for parallel multipliers, Alta Frequenza 34, 1965: heights 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 13, 19, 28, 42, 63
  • C. S. Wallace, A suggestion for a fast multiplier, IEEE Trans. Electronic Computers EC-13, 1964
